title: Manim Code
prompt:
Create a complete, executable Python script using Manim (Community Edition) to visualize and explain the mathematical chain rule: (f(g(x)))' = f'(g(x)) * g'(x).

Requirements:
- Define a clean Scene subclass (e.g. ChainRuleScene).
- Use MathTex to display the formula breakdown step-by-step.
- Graphically animate an inner function g(x) and an outer function f(u) to show how changes in x propagate through g to f.
- Include concise on-screen labels and smooth transitions.
- Ensure all imports and syntax are compatible with modern Manim.
